wholePhysicalScope: The map controls the standing outline and distinguishes distinct building volumes. Numeric one-metre surface samples constrain major roof heights and establish the modern wings.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the Doric portico, stepped basement and hipped dormer roofs over the hotel wings.
limitations: The archival images show the original hotel. Modern wing detail, infill and rear service entrances are inferred from the footprint and numeric roof surveys.
Roof finish, trim colors, parapet detailing and small rear openings are estimates.
